verificationUnavailable.meaning: From first recorded audit deferral until a scoped audit succeeds or observation ends. Flow collection may continue; no watermark advancement or entry permission is inferred.

closedWindows.coverage: Recorded confirmed pool-history audit scope only; not full market or proven receive-time/finality completeness.

entryControls.meaning: Literal successful-resume control flag intervals; not simultaneous strategy qualification, fresh quotes, exposure or complete risk permission.

decisions.qualifiedButNotFilledAssessment: Joined bounded order/attempt records below; decision points are not automatically reservations.

naturalPaper.source: Unique filled order IDs in recorded trader-execution events; confirm against completed financial journal when provided.

limitations: Metrics end at the selected snapshot timestamp; later captured records are excluded, and a running status is provisional.
Age-eligible collection, audited feature-ready lookbacks, control-enabled intervals and full qualification are different measurements.
Overlapping60s windows are unioned; their count times60 is not continuous eligible trading time.
Audit availability is retained separately from window end; confirmation or history cannot be backdated into decisions.
Control duration needs durable action results: a resume journal entry alone may have returned enabled:false.
Qualification is observed at discrete decision times; continuous qualification or missed economic outcomes cannot be reconstructed from sparse observations.
No P&L, hypothetical fill or unobserved threshold crossing is manufactured. API fees, infrastructure and simulated execution costs retain their original classifications.
